mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (user_id, event, skill_id, skill_name, message, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{event}, #{skillId}, #{skillName}, #{message}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (read IS NULL OR read = false) ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET read = #{read} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE notification SET read = true WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (read IS NULL OR read = false)
